name: claudecode-slack-collab
description: Real-time collaboration between Claude Code sessions via threaded topics - local (in-process) or over a shared Slack channel

slack_profile.title: Slack profile (optional)
slack_profile.description: Selects the credentials file at ~/.config/claudecode-slack-collab/credentials-<profile>.json. Leave blank to use the default credentials file. Set this when running multiple Slack identities on one machine.

default_slack_channel.title: Default Slack channel (optional)
default_slack_channel.description: Slack channel name (without leading #) to auto-join on startup. Topics default to this channel instead of local. Leave blank to default to local topics.

broker_id.title: Broker ID (optional)
broker_id.description: Identifier for the local broker process. Sessions sharing a broker ID share local topics, Slack connections, and discovery. Leave blank to use the default shared broker. Set a unique value to run an isolated broker (e.g. 'test' for development against a test Slack workspace).
